words.definition: A set of rules or procedures for solving a problem
words.definationTranslation: Kisi samasya ka hal nikalne ke liye niyam ya prakriyaon ka samuh

sentence.sentence: The company uses a complex algorithm to personalize user experience.
sentence.translation: Company vyaktigat upyogkar anubhav ko vyaktikrit karne ke liye jatil algorithm ka upyog karti hai.

sentence.sentence: The algorithm helps to optimize the system's performance.
sentence.translation: Algorithm pranali ki karyashamta ko anusuchit karne mein madad karta hai.

words.definition: Made or produced by human beings, especially using science and technology
words.definationTranslation: Mansiya bani ya utpann, vishesh roop se vigyaan aur praudyogiki ka upyog karke

sentence.sentence: The artificial intelligence system can learn and adapt quickly.
sentence.translation: Kritrim buddhimatta pranali jaldi seekh sakti hai aur anukoolit ho sakti hai.

sentence.sentence: The company is working on developing artificial organs for transplantation.
sentence.translation: Company pratishtapna ke liye kritrim angon ka vikas kar rahi hai.

words.definition: A prejudice or partiality in favor of one group or idea
words.definationTranslation: Ek samuh ya vichar ke paksh mein pakshpatriya ya purvagraha

sentence.sentence: The media's bias towards the government was evident in their reporting.
sentence.translation: Media ka sarkar ke prati pakshpatriya unke pradan mein spashth tha.

sentence.sentence: The researcher tried to eliminate bias from the study's results.
sentence.translation: Anusandhanakarta ne adhyayan ke parinaamon se pakshpatriya ko hatane ki koshish ki.

words.definition: A remote storage system for digital data
words.definationTranslation: Digital data ke liye doorasth bhandaaran pranali

sentence.translation: Company apne data ko surakshit badal bhandaaran pranali mein sanrakshit karti hai.

sentence.sentence: The cloud computing platform provides flexible and scalable infrastructure.
sentence.translation: Badal computing platform lachila aur uparjanak infrastraktur pradan karta hai.

words.definition: The practice of protecting digital information and systems from unauthorized access
words.definationTranslation: Anadhikrit pravaesh se digital soochana aur pranaliyon ki raksha ka abhyas

sentence.sentence: The company invests heavily in cybersecurity measures to protect its data.
sentence.translation: Company apne data ki raksha ke liye saiber suraksha upayon mein bhaari nivesh karti hai.

sentence.sentence: Cybersecurity is a major concern for businesses operating online.
sentence.translation: Saiber suraksha online kaaryarat karne vale vyavsayon ke liye ek bada chinta ka vishay hai.

words.definition: Facts or information, especially in a numerical form
words.definationTranslation: Tathy ya soochana, vishesh roop se sankhyatmak roop mein

sentence.sentence: The researcher used data from various sources to support her argument.
sentence.translation: Anusandhanakarta ne apne argument ko samarthan dene ke liye vividh strotro se data ka upyog kiya.

words.definition: Relating to or using computer technology or electronic devices
words.definationTranslation: Computer prayog ya electronic upkarnon se sambandhit ya upyog karne wali

sentence.sentence: The digital revolution has transformed the way we live and work.
sentence.translation: Digital kranti ne hamare jeevan aur kaam karne ke tareeke ko badal diya hai.

sentence.sentence: The company offers digital solutions to help businesses grow.
sentence.translation: Company vyavsayon ko vridhi karne mein madad karne ke liye digital samadhan pradan karti hai.

words.definition: The process of converting plaintext into unreadable code
words.definationTranslation: Spath roop ko apath roop mein parivaartit karne ki prakriya

sentence.sentence: The company uses encryption to protect sensitive data from unauthorized access.
sentence.translation: Company sankriptikaran ka upyog anadhikrit pravaesh se sansnivad data ki raksha ke liye karti hai.

sentence.translation: Sankriptikaran surakshit online len-den ke liye ek aavashyak upkaran hai.

words.definition: A system or network that monitors and controls incoming and outgoing network traffic
words.definationTranslation: Ek pranali ya jalaivihar jo aagaman aur nirgaman jalaivihar traffic ko niyantrit karta hai

sentence.sentence: The company installed a firewall to protect its network from cyber threats.
sentence.translation: Company ne apne jalaivihar ko saiber khatron se bachane ke liye ek agni-dwaar sthaapit kiya.

sentence.sentence: The firewall blocked the malicious traffic from reaching the internal network.
sentence.translation: Agni-dwaar ne hanikarak traffic ko antim jalaivihar tak pahunchne se rok diya.

words.definition: The act of gaining unauthorized access to a computer system or network
words.definationTranslation: Computer pranali ya jalaivihar mein anadhikrit pravaesh prapt karne ka karya

sentence.translation: Company ne apni pranali ko haeking se bachane ke liye visheshagyon ka ek team bharti kiya.

sentence.sentence: Hacking is a serious crime that can have severe consequences.
sentence.translation: Haeking ek gambhir apradh hai jo gambhir parinaam la sakta hai.

words.definition: A global system of interconnected computer networks

sentence.translation: Internet ne hamare sanchar aur soochana prapt karne ke tareeke ko kranti la di hai.

sentence.sentence: The company provides internet services to millions of customers worldwide.
sentence.translation: Company vishva bhar mein lakho grahakon ko internet sevaayein pradan karti hai.

words.definition: Software that is designed to harm or exploit a computer system
words.definationTranslation: Ek computer pranali ko nuksaan pahunchane ya uska durupyog karne ke liye design kiya gaya software

sentence.sentence: The company installed anti-malware software to protect its system from cyber threats.
sentence.translation: Company ne apni pranali ko saiber khatron se bachane ke liye durghatnak virodhi software sthaapit kiya.

sentence.sentence: The malware infected the computer and caused it to crash.
sentence.translation: Durghatnak ne computer ko sankramit kiya aur use girne ke liye majboor kiya.

words.definition: A system of interconnected computers or devices
words.definationTranslation: Samparkit computer ya upkarnon ka pranali

sentence.sentence: The company has a large network of computers and devices.
sentence.translation: Company ke paas computer aur upkarnon ka ek bada jalaivihar hai.

sentence.sentence: The network allows employees to share files and communicate with each other.
sentence.translation: Jalaivihar karmitiyon ko file saajha karne aur ek doosre se sanchar karne ki anumati deta hai.

words.definition: A secret word or phrase used to gain access to a computer system or network

sentence.sentence: The user forgot their password and was unable to log in.
sentence.translation: Upyogkarta ne apna password bhul gaya aur login nahin kar saka.

sentence.sentence: The company requires employees to change their passwords regularly.
sentence.translation: Company karmitiyon ko niyamit roop se apne passwords badalne ki aavashyakta hai.

words.definition: The act of attempting to obtain sensitive information by masquerading as a trustworthy entity
words.definationTranslation: Vishvasniya entiti ke roop mein sankriya karke sansnived data prapt karne ka prayaas

sentence.sentence: The company warned employees about phishing attacks and how to avoid them.
sentence.translation: Company ne karmitiyon ko phishing hamle aur unse bachne ke tareeke ke baare mein chetavani di.

sentence.sentence: The phishing email looked legitimate, but it was actually a scam.
sentence.translation: Phishing email vaastavik lag raha tha, lekin vah vaastav mein ek thugbaji tha.

words.definition: The state of being free from unauthorized access or observation
words.definationTranslation: Anadhikrit pravaesh ya avlokan se mukt avastha

sentence.sentence: The company respects its customers' right to privacy.
sentence.translation: Company apne grahakon ki gopniyata ke adhikar ka samman karti hai.

sentence.sentence: The government has introduced new laws to protect citizens' privacy.
sentence.translation: Sarkar ne nagrikon ki gopniyata ka raksha karne ke liye naye kanoon prastut kiye hain.

words.definition: The state of being protected from danger or harm
words.definationTranslation: Khatre ya hanik se surakshit avastha

sentence.sentence: The company takes security very seriously and has measures in place to protect its assets.
sentence.translation: Company suraksha ko bahut gmbhir leti hai aur apne sansadhanon ki raksha ke liye upay sthaapit karte hain.

sentence.sentence: The security team is responsible for protecting the company's network and data.
sentence.translation: Suraksha team company ke jalaivihar aur data ki raksha ke liye jimmedar hai.

words.definition: A computer or device that manages access to a network or provides services to clients
words.definationTranslation: Ek computer ya upkaran jo jalaivihar mein pravaesh ko niyantrit karta hai ya grahakon ko sevaayein pradan karta hai

sentence.sentence: The company has multiple servers to manage its network and provide services to clients.
sentence.translation: Company ke paas apne jalaivihar ko niyantrit karne aur grahakon ko sevaayein pradan karne ke liye kai server hain.

sentence.sentence: The server is responsible for managing the company's email and data storage.
sentence.translation: Server company ke email aur data bhandaaran ko niyantrit karne ke liye jimmedar hai.

words.definition: Programs or operating systems used by computers
words.definationTranslation: Computer dwara upyog kiye jaane wale karyakram ya operating system

sentence.sentence: The company develops and sells software to help businesses manage their operations.
sentence.translation: Company vyavsayon ko apne operations ko niyantrit karne mein madad karne ke liye software viksit karta hai aur bechta hai.

sentence.sentence: The software is designed to be user-friendly and easy to install.
sentence.translation: Software upyogkarta-mitr aur aasan sthaapit karne ke liye design kiya gaya hai.

words.definition: The application of scientific knowledge for practical purposes

sentence.sentence: The company uses technology to improve its products and services.

sentence.sentence: Technology has changed the way we live and work.
sentence.translation: Praudyogiki ne hamare jeevan aur kaam karne ke tareeke ko badal diya hai.

words.definition: A piece of code that replicates itself and can cause harm to a computer system
words.definationTranslation: Ek code ka tukda jo apne aap ko pratikrit karta hai aur computer pranali ko hanik pahuncha sakta hai

sentence.sentence: The company installed antivirus software to protect its system from viruses.
sentence.translation: Company ne apni pranali ko virus se bachane ke liye antivirus software sthaapit kiya.

sentence.sentence: The virus infected the computer and caused it to crash.
sentence.translation: Virus ne computer ko sankramit kiya aur use girne ke liye majboor kiya.

words.definition: A set of related web pages, including text, images, and other content
words.definationTranslation: Sambandhit web page ka samuh, jisme text, chitra, aur anya vishay shamil hain

sentence.sentence: The company has a website that provides information about its products and services.
sentence.translation: Company ke paas ek websait hai jo apne utpadon aur sevaon ke baare mein jaankari pradan karti hai.

sentence.sentence: The website is easy to navigate and provides a user-friendly interface.
sentence.translation: Websait aasan hai aur upyogkarta-mitr interface pradan karti hai.
